layers.name: Application Entry Points
layers.description: CLI and browser bootstrap that load environment/config and start the Strategist orchestrator or the React control-room app

layers.name: Control Room
layers.description: Live operations layer: WebSocket directive broker, HTTP server, and React UI for monitoring the deliberation loop and interjecting mid-run

layers.name: Orchestration Engine
layers.description: Core deliberation orchestration: stage machine, event bus, budget governor, persona task scheduling, and artifact writing that drive a Strategist run

layers.name: Agent Execution
layers.description: LLM provider detection, agent runner, structured output parsing, and tool registration that execute the persona prompts

layers.name: Research Ingestion
layers.description: Ingests sponsor, event, and past-winner research data from HTML and CSV sources to feed the deliberation loop; now includes browser automation and auth-gated fetch escalation

layers.name: Domain Data & Scoring
layers.description: Shared domain types, idea pool, and scoring model consumed across the engine, agents, research, and control room

layers.name: Configuration
layers.description: Runtime config schema, env loading, and defaults, plus event definitions, build tooling, and project-level configuration files

layers.name: Agent Personas & Skills
layers.description: The multi-agent system definitions: personas, operating rules, and skills that shape how each research, creation, decision, and review agent behaves

layers.name: Documentation
layers.description: Project planning and design documents describing the system purpose, specification, rubric, and implementation plan

layers.name: Generated Artifacts
layers.description: Run outputs produced by the Strategist for each event: briefs, evidence dossiers, implementation plans, shortlists, and spec docs
